Lina Gomez: Heads-up: onboarding zephyr-32k (community fork) hit a weird RoPE phase-warp after ~28k tokens when run in int8. Generation starts to hallucinate repeated metadata lines. Minimal repro below.

Yuki Chen: can you share the exact build/quant CLI and the tokenizer? also which shard config?

Lina Gomez: repro:
```
MODEL=zephyr-32k
QUANT=int8
ROPE_STRATEGY=exponential_scale
SHARDS=4
TOKENIZER=bytelevel-bpe-50k
run_inference --model $MODEL --quant $QUANT --max-tokens 30000 --prompt-file long_transcript.txt --emit-kv-dump /tmp/kvz
```
Observed: attention phase heatmap shows sharp discontinuity at token ~28112, repetition of a 3-line footer.

Aaron Park: interesting. exponential_scale is new for this model family, maybe training used a hybrid RoPE schedule. Do you have a training manifest?

Lina Gomez: manifest from upstream: `rope_schedule: hybrid_expo_linear`, but onboard script defaulted to `exponential_scale` — oops.

Olivia Martin: that'll do it. mismatch between manifest and runtime schedule -> phase drift across long contexts. two things: 1) try `ROPE_STRATEGY=hybrid_expo_linear` and 2) check kv index continuity across shard handoff with `--kv-verify`.

Kendall Wu: also compare fp16 run vs int8 to rule out quant-induced interpolation noise. small diff in rotary sine/cosine precision can blow up after many rotations. Can you run fp16 up to 30k and diff logits?

Lina Gomez: kicked off quick runs: fp16 baseline and int8. attaching short summary: fp16 stable to 30k, int8 reproduces footer repetition at ~28.1k. kv-verify shows repeated index entry at the boundary between shard 2 and 3.

ci-bot: CI job #1209: zephyr-32k-integration (pr/512) started  logs -> https://ci.redwood/1209

Yuki Chen: repeated index entry suggests our coalescing logic didn't merge tail tokens when shards rotate. try `--kv-coalesce-mode=aggressive` to force merge and see if repetition stops. Also try `--rope-compat=hybrid_expo_linear`.

Lina Gomez: ran `--kv-coalesce-mode=aggressive + --rope-compat=hybrid_expo_linear`  interim: no repetition in 30k quick pass. will run overnight long-run.

Aaron Park: if that fixes it, we should add onboarding checks: 1) validate manifest rope_schedule == runtime ROPE_STRATEGY, 2) stream test to 2x declared window and assert no phase wrap/repeat, 3) kv integrity check across shard boundaries.

Olivia Martin: adding to eval harness: gap/diff metrics for logits and a small checksum on kv indices. pushing a PR with tests.

Kendall Wu: follow-up note: we should log the exact rotary sin/cos table generation method in the model manifest (sampling freq, dtype, and seed) so quant backends can re-create identical tables. small mismatch in table rounding explains int8 sensitivity.

Lina Gomez: filed INF-2001: zephyr-32k: rope schedule mismatch + shard coalesce test added. cc @Yuki @Olivia. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2001

Yuki Chen: nice. next step: automated manifest lint on onboarding CI to reject rope_schedule/runtime mismatch. I can add a lint rule.

ci-bot: CI job #1209 updated: zephyr-32k-integration pr/512  tests queued

Lina Gomez: thanks all. will upload full kv dumps and fp16 vs int8 diffs into the ticket once the overnight completes. :sleeping:
